name: Names and semantic understanding
about: Investigate a bounded function family or owned type with evidence
title: "[Names] "
---

## Scope and stable identity

List canonical program/module/address/mode identities, owned types and affected files. Link related reconstruction issues and active claims.

## Proposed meaning and evidence

Describe callers, callees, fields, lifetime, units, tables or script bindings that support the proposal. Separate direct observations, public-library correspondence and hypotheses. Record alternatives and unresolved cases; preserve unknown names where evidence is insufficient.

## Acceptance criteria

Define the investigation needed and its complete affected-use scope. A source rename must update mappings, declarations and uses, preserve embedded strings and representation, and pass applicable object/link, behavior and data checks. Semantic confidence and matching status are separate claims.

## Claim and handoff

Read comments, claim a bounded file/family and recheck for a concurrent claim. Coordinate shared types. Post commits, evidence, checks actually run and remaining questions; release unfinished claims. Close only when the agreed scope has been reviewed, including deliberate unresolved names.

Do not attach original game files, extracted payloads, hybrid images, keys or saves. Use sanitized evidence and reproducible references.
